done: BASE: master 7799dbf, in worktree concordance-2-aimarks on branch ai-era-marks. One step, marks. It ships after green CI in two moves through the gated paths docs/HARNESS.md names: an ordinary sh tools/deploy.sh of the step's files (data/sticks is the one tracked data exception), then, for each new listing line, sh tools/deploy.sh --mint-check <name> && sh tools/deploy.sh --mint <name>. Nothing is minted any other way.

MEASURE, before any file is written, by the builder and re-done by the step's checker, by public GETs named in their notes: the map, its determinant and the three points are read from Gao's paper (https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00222, version 2, Section 3.4, Theorem 3.3) and compared character for character with the goal's transcription; the announcement's date and its credit to an AI model are read from a public source that states them, and the entry says only what such a source states, naming it; Keller's paper is cited by author, title, journal, volume, year and pages, its DOI confirmed through Crossref; Anthropic's zeta report is read at https://www.anthropic.com/research/riemann-zeta for its numbers, dates, model, checking and review status. Anything a source does not state is left out of the entry, never filled in.

THE JACOBIAN ENTRY: data/sticks/jacobian_conjecture.json, a DATA entry (schema 1, its own aliases unique in the catalog, grepped against tools/tick.py's dispatch and every entry before it is written). Four seals, each through the mathematics verifier's equality check (artifact MATH_VERIFY), each expression written literally, with no shorthand the verifier does not parse: (det) the cofactor expansion of the 3x3 matrix whose entries are diff(f_i, x_j) for the three components and the variables x, y, z, claimed equal to -2, with variables [x, y, z]; (p1), (p2), (p3) for each of the three points, the sum of the squares of the differences between each component of F evaluated at that point and the matching component of (-1/4, 0, 0), claimed equal to 0, in exact rational arithmetic. One stick, question 'The Jacobian conjecture', field mathematics, its statement Keller's question for every n >= 2 and its references the sources the measure confirmed. Marks, each claim in its own words and none longer than tickstick.CLAIM_CAP: a witness on seal det naming F, its source and that the engine took the nine partial derivatives and expanded the determinant itself; a witness on each of p1, p2, p3 naming the point and its image; a note stating what the four seals settle (three distinct points share one image while the determinant never vanishes, so the conjecture is false in dimension three; identity coordinates carry it to every n > 3, as Gao states; dimension two remains open) and what they do not (the arithmetic is sealed; the map is a found source, re-derived and not authored; its review status as the sources state it). No mark of kind closed, since dimension two is open.

THE ZETA NOTE ENTRY: data/sticks/zeta_critical_line_proportion.json, a DATA entry with no seals and one stick, question 'Riemann hypothesis', which is the live stick_riemann_hypothesis (read by the lead 2026-11-13: 38 ticks), so tickstick.create finds it and changes nothing on it; one note mark, its claim beginning '[AI-era claim, NOT sealed, NOT peer-reviewed]' and stating, as the measure read them: the lower bound on the proportion of nontrivial zeros on the critical line, from 41.6% to 67.2%; who reported it, when, with what model; the Lean formalization and the expert reading the report names; that no journal review is reported; that the engine has not re-derived it; that a proportion bound, even at one hundred percent, is not the Riemann hypothesis; and that the hypothesis is open. It never says the hypothesis is proven, and names no finite-field result. If the path or the catalog refuses an entry with no seals, the step stops and says so; it does not add a seal to get past it.

GOLDENS AND THE LISTING: tests/fixtures/tick_golden/jacobian_conjecture.json and tests/fixtures/tick_golden/zeta_critical_line_proportion.json are made by python tools/tick_golden.py snapshot for those two names only, never the whole directory; every other golden is byte-identical to the base, and tests/test_sticks_catalog.py's parametrized golden test passes for both. tools/stick_mints.txt gains two lines, each after a comment saying what it mints and why, with no expect token: jacobian_conjecture with its entry hash and its four seal hashes from an isolated run (equal to its golden's), and zeta_critical_line_proportion with its entry hash and no seals. The listing test holds both. The three canary lines are unchanged.

WHAT THE MINT WILL WRITE, stated before the ship and checked after it: for jacobian_conjecture, four new CAS objects with their ledger records and receipt cards, one new stick with six marks; for zeta_critical_line_proportion, one note on stick_riemann_hypothesis and nothing else. The step's checker reproduces, in an isolated keeping holding a copy of the live Riemann stick's ticks (read by public GET), that the zeta entry adds exactly one mark there and no other.

REVERT, named: sh tools/deploy.sh --mint-retract jacobian_conjecture withdraws its four sealed marks; its stick and its two notes, the zeta note, and every CAS object, ledger record and receipt card stay, since a note has no withdrawal in the keeping (a want filed by run 2026-11-13-stick-ship). So every note's words are reviewed as tracked source before the mint, and the step's checker reads each claim against its sources.

UNCHANGED: no engine code changes (src/ byte-identical to the base); the full suite passes against the baseline; the moat holds; the deploy's gates hold. A WANT, named: chart the Jacobian stick on the one map (a chart card and its edge, through a pinned card build).

goal: The first content mint through the stick ship path (run 2026-11-13-stick-ship): the AI-era marks the owner chose, 2026-11-13 ('The AI-era marks'), after the lead's survey of mathematics done by AI that day. Two marks, each by what the engine can do with it. (1) SEALED, a new stick, the Jacobian conjecture (Keller 1939): Levent Alpöge's counterexample in dimension three, announced 2026-07-19 and credited to the search of an AI model, as printed in S. Gao, arXiv:2608.00222v2, Theorem 3.3: F = ((1+x*y)^3*z + y^2*(1+x*y)*(4+3*x*y), y + 3*x*(1+x*y)^2*z + 3*x*y^2*(4+3*x*y), 2*x - 3*x^2*y - x^3*z), with Jacobian determinant -2 and F(0, 0, -1/4) = F(1, -3/2, 13/2) = F(-1, 3/2, 13/2) = (-1/4, 0, 0). The engine re-derives both through its own mathematics verifier: measured by the lead on 2026-11-13 at 7799dbf, verify_equality confirms the 3x3 cofactor expansion of the nine diff(f_i, x_j) terms equals -2 (and refuses -3), and confirms each point's image exactly (and refuses a wrong point). (2) A NOTE, never a seal, on the existing Riemann stick: Anthropic's report (2026-08-10, revised 2026-08-13) that at least 67.2% of the nontrivial zeros of zeta lie on the critical line, up from 41.6%, with a Lean formalization and expert reading but no journal review; the engine has not re-derived it, a proportion bound is not the Riemann hypothesis, and the hypothesis stays open. Considered and left: the Exponential Time Hypothesis claim, already carried as an unverified note on the computer-science stick, whose independent review was still pending in the latest reporting the lead found (2026-11-02).

text: MEASURED by checker-102 for the plan (line 2), on a scratch copy of 7799dbf (git archive), python -I -B, every CONCORDANCE_ variable removed, tick_golden's environment. (1) THE SEAL PATH: an entry holding the plan's seal shape ({"key": "det", "domain": "mathematics", "artifact": "MATH_VERIFY", "spec": {"expr_a": <the first-row cofactor expansion of the nine diff(f_i, x_j)>, "expr_b": "-2", "variables": ["x", "y", "z"]}}) passes sticks.validate_entry. sticks.run on it prints 'did NOT hold: mathematics SYSTEM_ERROR', returns 1 and writes nothing, because the step's spec reaches derivation.verify_math with no mode ('unknown math mode'). On a stand-in box at 7799dbf, the real tools/stick_mint.py refuses that entry at step 2 ('the rehearsal's run returned 1'), with nothing written but its result. No catalog entry at 7799dbf has a verifier seal in the mathematics domain, and verifiers/__init__.py maps only 'mathematics' and 'math' to that module. (2) THE SAME CHECKS THROUGH {"mode": "equality", "params": ...}: det = -2 HOLDS (twice, the same hash); -3 BROKEN; the expansion with one cofactor sign wrong BROKEN; the transposed matrix's expansion HOLDS (det J^T = det J); each of the three points' sum of squared differences = 0 HOLDS by exact rational arithmetic; the wrong point (1, -3/2, 6) BROKEN, simplifying to 101/256; the near miss (1, -3/2, 6.5000000001) BROKEN, simplifying to 1.58e-20. The det expression is 660 characters and 758 AST nodes (limits 4000 and 2000). Its sealed detail is cut to 300 characters inside the echoed expression (derivation.py:191), so it shows neither -2 nor the reduced form. sympy alone: det of the Jacobian of the transcribed F is -2, and each point maps to (-1/4, 0, 0). (3) THE ZETA ENTRY, run with no seals by the real unit on a stand-in box holding the live stick_riemann_hypothesis (rebuilt from the GET below): status minted, ended at step 4, one note added; nothing changed outside data/mints/ but data/sticks.jsonl; the 38 earlier ticks read back unchanged, none superseded. The listing regex and mint_ship.sh's line pattern both allow a line with no seal. Aliases already taken: zeta (entry zeta), critical_line (entry symmetry). (4) THE SPINE CARD: on a stand-in box whose receipt_cards.jsonl already holds card_spine_seals, the real unit minting a two-seal numeric probe named no spine card in WOULD ADD, yet added three lines (card_spine_seals, then the two receipt cards); status minted, receipt_spine_cards_written 1. PUBLIC GETS (generic client, no redirects followed, no POST, no ssh), 2026-11-14T00:37Z to 00:40Z: https://narrowhighway.com/stick?id=stick_riemann_hypothesis 200 (38 ticks: 13 witness, 8 bound, 6 equivalence, 11 note; superseded 0; no note begins '[AI'); https://narrowhighway.com/stick?id=stick_the_jacobian_conjecture 404; https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00222 and its v2 200 (Gao, 'Counterexamples to the Jacobian conjecture in dimensions greater than two', v1 31 Jul 2026, v2 4 Nov 2026); https://arxiv.org/html/2608.00222v2 200: in Section 3.4, after Theorem 3.3 ('components of degrees 7,6,4; its Jacobian determinant is identically -2; and its generic fiber consists of exactly 3 points'), 'Written out in full' gives f1, f2, f3 and F(0,0,-1/4) = F(1,-3/2,13/2) = F(-1,3/2,13/2) = (-1/4,0,0), equal to the goal's up to notation. Gao says the conjecture was 'refuted in dimension three by an explicit counterexample announced by L. Alpoge [11]' on July 19, 2026, and credits no AI for it; his AI disclosure concerns his own paper (Claude Fable 5 and Codex). Reference [11] is an X post, https://x.com/__alpoge__/status/2079028340955197566, 200, whose text thanks 'my close friend akhil for asking about it and my other close friend fable for working during the world cup final' and gives the same map. Reference [15], https://terrytao.wordpress.com/2026/07/21/a-digestion-of-the-jacobian-conjecture-counterexample/, 200: 'It was recently shown (using the Fable AI) that the conjecture is false in three dimensions'; 'The conjecture remains open in two dimensions'. No source read says 'search'. https://www.anthropic.com/research/riemann-zeta 200: published Aug 10, 2026, and updated August 13, 2026, with an updated version of Claude's paper; 'An unreleased research version of Claude' raised the bound 'from 41.6% to 67.2%'; two Anthropic mathematicians validated the paper; Brian Conrey and Dan Goldston 'examined the paper on short notice'; a Lean formalization 'passes the standard validation tool comparator'; no journal or peer review is mentioned; no model is named Fable. https://api.crossref.org/works/10.1007/BF01695502 200: Ott-Heinrich Keller, 'Ganze Cremona-Transformationen', Monatshefte fur Mathematik und Physik 47(1), 299-306, 1939.
